comment: The STEP assembly of tools/ui-scripts/move-imported-assembly.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1891), run in the test's work folder and written there as imported.step: Pin (an 8 x 12 x 6 box from the origin) placed twice, Pin:1 at the origin and Pin:2 20 mm along Y. The export writes one assembly that places each part where the design shows it (no sub-assemblies), and two placements keep it an assembly when it is imported.
